Title: Authenticate as admin and store the session
Preconditions: Credentials in .env; PRE serves the static CAPTCHA 12345 (ISS-21)
Steps: 1) If a stored session exists, open /main/admin/Dashboard with it and wait for the drawer link. 2) If it renders and the URL is not under /auth/, keep it and stop. 3) Otherwise log in with email, password and CAPTCHA. 4) Confirm the operator name Admin 4. 5) Save storage state to playwright/.auth/admin.json
Expected Result: A usable admin session exists for the three downstream projects; verification is a plain GET so no login attempt is spent; a rejected login raises a named error stating the HTTP status (429 = SE0053 rate limit) rather than a navigation timeout
